showingAllContributions: Showing all contributions in this period, including repositories whose visibility has not been classified.
unablePRs: Unable to load pull requests. Connect GitHub and try Sync now.
activityLoadFailed: Some activity could not be loaded
availableResults: Available results are shown below. Retry to refresh missing data.
noRepos: No repositories yet. Connect GitHub and click Sync now.
oauthCancelled: GitHub authorization was cancelled. You can try connecting again.
noCommentsAvailable: No comments available in this response.
noAchievements: No contributions yet. Connect GitHub and sync.
yearBasis: Merged PRs use merge dates; unmerged PRs use creation dates (UTC).
historyScope: Based on the completed GitHub PR history sync.
historySyncNeeded: History is not fully synced. Click Sync now; an empty view does not mean no contributions.
noSyncedPrivate: No private PRs are synced for this period.
syncAlreadyRunning: A sync is already running. Please wait; no need to start another.
syncRateLimited: GitHub rate limit reached. Retry later.
syncForbidden: Sync request denied. Check GitHub access or page origin.
syncPartial: PR list saved, but some details failed. Retry later.
syncUpstreamError: GitHub sync did not complete. Retry later.
syncNetworkError: Cannot reach the sync service. Retry shortly.
privateAccessMissing: This GitHub App has no accessible installations, so private repositories cannot be read. Install it on the relevant account or organization, grant repository access, then sync.
accessCheckFailed: Unable to verify private repository access.
privatePermissionMissing: The app is installed but lacks PR read permission. Update permissions and approve them on the account or organization.
noTrendMerges: No merged PRs for this repository in this period.
firstSyncQueued: Your first sync is starting automatically. Your PRs will appear as they are imported.
firstSyncHelp: Importing your GitHub history can take a few minutes. You can leave this page; synchronization continues in the background.
autoSyncSchedule: Background sync · every 5 minutes, even with this page closed
syncTimeout: The sync timed out. It will retry automatically.
syncInterrupted: The sync was interrupted. It will retry automatically.
syncHistoryChanged: GitHub search results changed during sync. Retrying automatically; previous data is retained.
syncStorageError: Could not save sync data. Retrying automatically.
welcomeDescription: Connect GitHub to follow pull requests, reviews, and conflicts across all your repositories.
emptyResultsDescription: Try another keyword or clear the current filters.
refreshFailedKeepData: Update failed. Showing previously loaded data.
noActionNeeded: No pull requests need your attention right now.
noOpenResults: No open pull requests in this view.
aboutDescription: PR Desk is a personal dashboard for people contributing to multiple GitHub repositories. Keep track of your pull requests, reviews, and contribution history without switching between repositories.
aboutOverviewDescription: See contribution totals, merge trends, and repository distribution by year. View public and private repositories separately.
aboutAttentionDescription: Follow review requests, requested changes, conflicts, and discussion activity. Open a pull request directly to continue the conversation.
aboutSyncDescription: After the first history import, background incremental sync refreshes changes and open pull requests. Progress and retry states stay visible.
aboutGettingStartedDescription: Connect your GitHub account to import your pull requests. Grant the relevant organization and repository access when needed, then use the dashboard to explore your contributions and follow up on reviews.
welcomeSyncNote: Automatic updates after your first sync
welcomeFollowDescription: Find the reviews, changes, and conflicts that need your attention.
welcomeExploreDescription: Explore contribution trends and the repositories you contribute to.
welcomeUpdateDescription: Background sync keeps updates together, even when this tab is closed.
activityWarningReason_too_many_results: Too many results; open GitHub for the full activity
activityWarningReason_thread_permissions: Review thread status unavailable; check GitHub App permissions
